fusions.name: Locked Jaw
fusions.desc: Locks your jaws on the target, which deals 13 damage, stuns it for 1.5 seconds and leaves it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Driven to the Crossing
fusions.desc: Bursts out of the shallows through a cone 3 tiles long, which deals 28 damage to everything in it. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health. The effect grows 8% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Fast, Then Gorge
fusions.desc: Restores 22 health to you, rising 8% for every 10% of your health already gone (max 40%). The heal has a 10% chance to crit.

fusions.name: The Long Wait
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your next strike gains 40% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds. Anything you strike moves 15% slower for 2 seconds.
